app.name: Enkrnett
banner.development: Development build. Not for use in a venue.
channel.not_secure: This page is delivered inside your management Wi-Fi without a web certificate. Your management Wi-Fi encrypts it. Keep the management Wi-Fi password private.
notconnected.management: Not connected to the device. Join the management Wi-Fi "{name}" and this screen continues by itself.
notconnected.setup: Not connected to the device. Join the setup Wi-Fi again and this screen continues by itself.
state.changed: The device's state has changed. Updating the screen.
connection.owe: Your phone joined the setup Wi-Fi with encryption. What you enter here is protected on the radio link.
connection.none: Your phone joined the setup Wi-Fi without encryption. Someone within range could read what you enter here. If other people are nearby, set up with a newer phone or at a quieter time.
connection.unknown: Could not tell whether your phone's connection is encrypted.
connection.wpa2: Your phone uses the older protection on the management Wi-Fi. Someone who knows the management Wi-Fi password could read this session. Keep that password private. Newer phones do not have this limit.
start.title: Set up this device
identify.title: Is this the device?
identify.lead: Press Blink and look at the device's light.
identify.none: This device has no light Enkrnett can control. Check that the setup Wi-Fi's name ends in {suffix}, like the label.
country.title: Country or region
country.lead: Wi-Fi rules differ by country. Where is this device used?
guest.title: Guest Wi-Fi
names.before: Guests see this name on their phones. Up to {max} characters. Japanese and other full-width characters count as 3 each, because a Wi-Fi name has a fixed size.
names.over_open: In "Open to every device" the name can use at most 29. Shorten it by {k} first.
names.management: Your phone shows this name when you join the management Wi-Fi. Up to 32 characters, counted the same way.
mode.label: Who can join
mode.open.line: Devices that can encrypt do; older devices connect without encryption.
mode.encrypted.line: Older devices cannot join this network.
password.title: Owner password
password.label: Owner password
password.rules: 10 to 64 characters: letters, numbers, and symbols you can type on any keyboard. Not a Wi-Fi name, not the management Wi-Fi password, not a common password.
password.keep: Keep it somewhere safe. If it is lost, the only way back is Erase, and you set up again.
password.enter: You enter it whenever you change anything.
password.change.title: Change owner password
password.change.lead: Enter the current password and the new one. Every phone, including this one, is logged out.
password.changed: The password was changed. Log in again.
keep.title: Keep these
keep.lead: Keep these. You need them in a moment. This phone cannot scan its own screen: write them down or take a screenshot.
keep.qr_wifi: Scan with another phone to join the management Wi-Fi
keep.qr_address: Scan with another phone to open the settings screen
join.title: Join the management Wi-Fi
login.title: Log in
login.forgot: Forgot it? The only way back is Erase: hold the small button on the back for five seconds until the light changes.
status.title: Status
status.drift: Settings were changed outside Enkrnett. Restore my settings?
status.hardening: Some protections of this device are not in place. See Details.
update.unreachable: Could not reach the update server. Check the Internet connection.
update.bad: The update information could not be verified and was not used.
update.stale: The update information received is older than what this device already knows and was not used.
update.available: Update available: Enkrnett {v}. Installing takes about {m} minutes. The Wi-Fi stops meanwhile. This cannot be undone from here.
update.changes_baseline: This one takes longer and restarts the Wi-Fi twice.
update.installing: Installing. The Wi-Fi stops for about two minutes. Come back to this address afterwards.
update.failed.health_check_failed: The update was installed, but the device could not start your Wi-Fi with it and is using your previous settings.
update.failed.bad_signature: The update file could not be verified. Nothing was changed.
update.failed.wrong_device: This update is not for this device.
update.failed.wrong_baseline: This update cannot follow the installed version directly.
update.failed.not_enough_memory: Not enough free memory. Restart the device and try again.
update.failed.download_failed: The update could not be downloaded. Check the Internet connection and try again.
update.disabled: This device was not installed from a published image, so it does not look for updates.
settings.title: Settings
settings.mode_warning.one: 1 device connected now is not encrypted. It loses the guest Wi-Fi when you save.
settings.mode_warning.other: {u} devices connected now are not encrypted. They lose the guest Wi-Fi when you save.
settings.mode_note: Encrypted devices may take a few minutes to come back.
settings.country: Country or region: {c}. Changed only by Erase.
settings.needs_join: Saving this changes the management Wi-Fi. Every phone, including this one, must join it again within 10 minutes.
change.applying: Saving… The Wi-Fi restarts for a few seconds.
change.waiting_confirmation: Saved. Join the new management Wi-Fi within 10 minutes, or the change is undone.
change.undone.health_check_failed: Not saved: the device could not start the Wi-Fi this way. Your previous settings are back.
change.undone.not_confirmed: Undone: the new management Wi-Fi was not joined in time. Your previous settings are back.
change.undone.restart: A change from before the restart was not finished and has been undone.
change.detail.guest_down: The guest Wi-Fi did not start.
change.detail.management_down: The management Wi-Fi did not start.
change.detail.isolation_missing: Devices could not be kept apart from each other.
change.detail.dhcp_missing: Devices would not have received an address.
change.detail.listener_exposed: The settings screen would have been reachable from the guest Wi-Fi.
change.detail.pmf_missing: The encrypted connection could not be set up with the required protection.
change.detail.mode_differs: The Wi-Fi did not run in the chosen mode.
mgmt.title: Management Wi-Fi
mgmt.name: Name
mgmt.replace.lead: Every device on the management Wi-Fi, including this phone, must join again with the new password. You will have 10 minutes.
erase.title: Erase
erase.lead: Erase removes everything you set up: the guest Wi-Fi, the management Wi-Fi, and the owner password. The device returns to how it was after installation and restarts. You then set it up again from the beginning. Enter the owner password to erase.
erase.after: Erasing. The device restarts and opens its setup Wi-Fi in about two minutes.
restart.title: Restart
restart.lead: Restart turns the device off and on. The Wi-Fi stops for about a minute. Nothing changes.
restart.after: Restarting. Come back to this address in about a minute.
details.title: Details
protects.title: What this protects
notice.title: Wi-Fi "{name}"
notice.p1: This Wi-Fi encrypts the connection between your device and the access point if your device supports it (most phones and laptops since about 2020; the standard is called "Enhanced Open" or "OWE"). Older devices connect without encryption.
notice.p2: The encryption covers the radio link only. It does not check who runs the network, it does not protect you from a fake network with the same name, and it does not protect what happens beyond this access point. Use websites and apps that encrypt end to end (the lock in your browser) for anything private.
notice.p3: Devices on this Wi-Fi are kept apart from each other and from the shop's or venue's own network by the access point. This reduces, but does not remove, what another guest could attempt.
notice.p4: This access point keeps no record of the devices that connect to it.
compat.text: Devices that can encrypt: phones and tablets with Android 10 or later on a capable chip, iPhone 11 or later with iOS 16.1 or later, Macs with macOS 13 or later, and Windows 10 version 2004 or later with a capable Wi-Fi driver.
error.no_session: You were logged out. Log in again.
error.try_later: Too many attempts. Try again in {s} seconds.
error.wrong_state: The device's state has changed. Updating the screen.
error.setup_in_progress_elsewhere: Setup is in progress on another phone. If that is not you, unplug the device, wait ten seconds, and plug it in again.
error.version_mismatch: The settings changed since you opened this screen. Showing the current ones.
error.change_pending: A change is still in progress. Wait for it to finish.
error.update_in_progress: An update is in progress. Nothing can be changed until it finishes.
error.generic: Something went wrong on the device (reference {ref}). Try again. If it repeats, restart the device.
field.forbidden_characters: Contains characters that cannot be used.
field.common_password: This is a commonly used password.
field.equals_network_name: Must differ from the Wi-Fi name.
field.equals_key: Must differ from the management Wi-Fi password.
field.equals_device_id: Must differ from the device identifier.
